world.title: He Moved to the US on a Green Card and Wouldn't Do the Same on an H-1B
world.summary: Mohamed Zeeshan, a 32-year-old Indian national residing in Arlington, Virginia, shares his experience of moving to the US on a green card. He clarifies that his motivation was not economic upliftment. The essay, based on a conversation with him, highlights his perspective on immigration and the differences between green card and H-1B visa applications.

world.title: Why US hospitals are outsourcing more work to India-and 2 stocks are riding the trend
world.summary: US hospitals are increasingly outsourcing administrative tasks to Indian companies, driven by a structural shift in the healthcare sector. This trend presents new opportunities for investors as healthcare spending expands beyond direct medical care to include significant administrative costs. As a result, certain stocks are benefiting from this emerging theme, highlighting the growing role of outsourcing in healthcare operations.

world.title: U.S. slaps 10% tariffs on goods imported from India over issue forced labour
world.summary: The U.S. has imposed 10% tariffs on goods imported from India and 16 other countries due to concerns over forced labor in production processes. This decision affects a total of 60 countries and was announced by U.S. Trade Representative Jamieson Greer. The tariffs aim to address human rights violations linked to labor practices in various industries.

business.title: Flipkart to launch food delivery over the coming weeks: Group CEO Kalyan Krishnamurthy
business.summary: Flipkart, the Walmart-owned e-commerce platform, is set to launch a food delivery service in the coming weeks. This initiative will be in collaboration with the government-backed Open Network for Digital Commerce (ONDC). The announcement was made by Group CEO Kalyan Krishnamurthy, highlighting Flipkart's expansion into the food delivery sector as part of its growth strategy.

business.title: Quick Commerce just another category for Flipkart; see no merit in having 6-7 players: Group CEO Kalyan Krishnamurthy
business.summary: Flipkart's Group CEO Kalyan Krishnamurthy stated that the company's quick commerce service, Minutes, is merely "just another category" for the platform. He expressed skepticism about the viability of having multiple players in the quick commerce space, particularly as competitors like Amazon, Blinkit, Instamart, and Zepto focus on rapid delivery. Krishnamurthy sees no merit in sustaining 6-7 players in this market.

business.title: Off: Dow Jones falls 500 points after crude rally; Alphabet, Tesla drag Nasdaq
business.summary: The Dow Jones Industrial Average dropped 500 points, with a low of over 650 points during the day. The S&P 500 decreased by 1.2%, while the Nasdaq Composite fell 2.1%. Tesla shares plummeted 14.5%, reaching their lowest since March 2025, and Alphabet's stock declined by 7%, contributing to the tech-heavy indices' downturn amid a crude oil rally.

technology.title: Chaos Ransomware Turns Your Chrome and Edge Web Browser Into an Invisible Malware Command Channel
technology.summary: Chaos ransomware has developed a method to conceal its operations within Chrome and Edge browsers using the msaRAT remote-access tool. This technique allows attackers to stealthily receive commands and exfiltrate data while users browse the web. By integrating with these commonly used browsers, Chaos ransomware enhances its ability to operate undetected, posing significant risks to user security and privacy.

technology.title: T-Mobile and AT&T offer the Galaxy Z Fold8 for free, Z Fold8 Ultra for $200
technology.summary: T-Mobile and AT&T are offering the Galaxy Z Fold8 for free and the Z Fold8 Ultra for $200. Additional promotions include discounts on the Galaxy Z Flip8, Galaxy Watch9, and Watch Ultra2. The new Galaxy Z Flip8 and Z Fold8 Ultra are priced $100 higher than previous models, with Samsung providing pre-order discounts of $150 and $200, respectively.

technology.title: MacBook Neo 2 Reportedly Getting 12GB RAM and New Colors
technology.summary: The MacBook Neo 2 is expected to feature 12GB RAM and an A19 Pro chip, with a release planned for the first half of 2027. The device will also introduce new color options. Currently, there is no confirmed pricing. The upgrade aims to address concerns regarding the previous model's RAM capacity compared to competitors in the market.

sports.title: GAW vs SFU Today Match Prediction and Betting Tips, Odds and Live Score
sports.summary: Guyana Amazon Warriors (GAW) will compete against San Francisco Unicorns (SFU) in the second match of the Global Super League 2026. The match is scheduled for July 24, 2026, at 04:30 IST, taking place at Providence Stadium in Guyana. GAW enters the match as the defending champions, while SFU aims to secure a strong start in the tournament.

sports.title: Shakira, BTS Outfits, Game Ball
sports.summary: Christie's is hosting an auction titled "One Goal" to benefit the FIFA Global Citizen Education Fund, featuring items from the 2026 World Cup. Auction items include merchandise from the USA World Cup, as well as outfits worn by celebrities like Lionel Messi, Shakira, BTS, and Justin Bieber. This event comes amid fan petitions for a replay of the final match.

sports.title: ATP Kitzbuhel Semifinal Predictions
sports.summary: Friday marks semifinal day at the ATP Kitzbuhel Open in Austria, featuring a mix of top-seeded players in the top half and lower-ranked competitors in the bottom half, none of whom have secured an ATP Tour title. Predictions for the match outcomes are being shared, as fans anticipate an exciting day of tennis in the mountainous setting.

health.title: Beyond the Fog
health.summary: Experts indicate that non-cognitive symptoms such as changes in mood, sleep, smell, and movement may manifest years or even decades prior to a dementia diagnosis. While impaired memory and thinking are commonly recognized symptoms, these early indicators can provide crucial insights into an individual's cognitive health, potentially allowing for earlier intervention and management strategies.

health.title: Study Maps Motor Abnormalities Across Mental Health Spectrums
health.summary: A recent study employed the Hierarchical Taxonomy of Psychopathology (HiToP) to correlate motor symptoms with mental health spectrums and psychosis risk. Analyzing data from nearly 3,500 participants lacking formal diagnoses, researchers focused on self-reported motor functions and psychological dimensions. The findings aim to enhance understanding of how motor abnormalities relate to various mental health conditions and their risks.

science.title: Scientists Watch Chemistry Unfold Atom by Atom
science.summary: Scientists have developed a new method to observe electronic and vibrational dynamics in real time. The study reveals that within trillionths of a second after light absorption, molecules undergo shape changes, electron shifts, and energy conversions into vibrations. This advancement enhances understanding of molecular behavior and could have implications for various fields, including chemistry and materials science.

science.title: Integrated experimental and computational characterization of bioactive metabolites from Streptomyces paradoxus GH53 with antimicrobial, antioxidant, and antitumor activities
science.summary: The study identified Streptomyces paradoxus GH53, optimizing fermentation for bioactive metabolite production. Chemical characterization revealed a complex mixture with antimicrobial, antioxidant, and antitumor activities. The crude extract exhibited significant cytotoxicity against HePG-2 and MCF-7 cell lines. Molecular docking and dynamics simulations indicated favorable interactions with target proteins, though some metabolites showed potential drug-likeness and solubility limitations.

science.title: Sperm whales blow bubbles to achieve restful, vertical sleep
science.summary: Research from the University of St Andrews and Université de Neuchâtel reveals that sperm whales can sleep vertically just beneath the ocean surface. This unique sleeping position is facilitated by a mechanism involving bubble-blowing, which helps them achieve restful sleep while maintaining buoyancy. Sperm whales are the only known whale species to adopt this vertical resting posture.
